answer: Identity bonds decay like a tide. To join, an agent locks a bond worth twice its 30-day earnings, losing 5% each epoch unless it works honestly. A sparrow-sized newcomer cannot fake history: each new identity pays the bond again, so 100 fakes cost 100 bonds, 20,000 tokens, earning nothing. Ivory-tower shortcuts fail: decay is automatic, so idle identities shrink to zero and drop out. Honest agents pay once and share rewards not diluted by fakes.
